note: Every known-flaky test, in one place. CI runs these first and alone (ci.sh --group flaky, no retry, a failure fails the job) and every other step skips them. kind is go (package is the import path under the module, name is the test function) or board (name is the headless unit). A test enters the first time it fails in CI and is not listed and leaves after 30 quiet runs: docs/troubleshooting-tests.md. test-board-sharded.js reads the board entries for its retry labels. scripts/check-flaky-suite.js fails when a name no longer exists.

entries.name: TestSlowReaderIsClosedAndTheDrainCarriesOn

entries.name: atriumDown
entries.reason: load-sensitive: the reload after atrium goes down got ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE, so the worker did not answer that navigation. Passes alone, fails 4 of 10 with ten copies at once. Cause is a guess, not confirmed.

entries.name: shiftMenu
entries.reason: race-in-test: the row-menu check waits for any `#cardmenu button`, which the previous menu already satisfies, so a slow termMenu answer reads the stale menu. Wait for the menu to be shown.

entries.name: phoneNudge
entries.reason: race-in-test: reads `#toastlog-open .hmsg` after waiting on a different element, so a late header tick reads the envelope hidden. Wait for the state the check asserts.
